verdict.rationale: Unreal documents its own Automation Test Framework for unit and feature testing, with smoke tests that run when a commandlet starts. Gauntlet runs real engine sessions to perform tests and validate results, and UAT automates testing and building, so the real-engine test core is delivered. Headless CI execution is only implied by commandlet and automation tooling, not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit docs for running the test suite headlessly (no-render/null-RHI) from the command line, CI integration guidance or result reporting, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, tests run headlessly — unit and integration tests of game code execute in CI against the real engine
